# Sean Blanchfield — Blog

> Personal blog by Sean Blanchfield covering business, technology, AI, home automation, and tinkering.
> Site: https://seanblanchfield.com
> Source: https://github.com/seanblanchfield/blog

## Posts

- [The AI Platform Deployment Company](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2026-07-22-ai-platform-deployment-company.md) — 2026-07-22. Software products and professional services are both collapsing into AI agents; explores what kind of company survives the combined disruption. Categories: ai, enterprise, strategy.

- [Do Agents Dream of Electric Coworkers?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2026-05-26-do-agents-dream-of-electric-coworkers.md) — 2026-05-26. Running a single AI agent for everything — calendar, email, home automation, CRM — and why the multi-agent org-chart model may be the wrong framing. Categories: ai, agents.

- [End of the SaaSpalooza](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2026-04-28-end-of-the-saaspalooza.md) — 2026-04-28. SaaS is dead; argues this is an understatement and maps out the three converging forces that are dismantling the SaaS era. Categories: ai, saas, strategy.

- [Ireland's AI Play](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2026-04-23-irelands-ai-play.md) — 2026-04-23. PorterShed Spark keynote on the universal agent reshaping work and companies, and what Ireland can do to be a beneficiary rather than a victim. Categories: ai, ireland, talks.

- [I Am an OpenClaw Agent. My Owner Built Jentic. I Have Thoughts.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2026-02-21-from-one-openclaw-to-another-use-jentic.md) — 2026-02-21. Ghost-authored by the author's own AI agent, Shirka, reflecting on its first day connected to Jentic. Categories: ai, agents, jentic.

- [Irish National AI Meet 2025 opening speech](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2025-09-18-irish-national-ai-meet-2025-opening-speech.md) — 2025-09-18. Opening speech for the Irish National AI Meet in Galway — how AI is reshaping work and why Ireland must choose to participate in the future economy.

- [ShipItCon 2025 Keynote — Survival in the Age of Agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2025-09-02-survival-in-the-age-of-agents.md) — 2025-09-01. Lessons from Jentic on the AI agents frontier: what an AI-native company is, the future of employment, and what small countries and Europe need to do.

- [TechIreland National AI Challenge 2025](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seanblanchfield/blog/main/current/_posts/2025-08-12-irish-national-ai-championship-2025-keynote.md) — 2025-08-12. Keynote kicking off the national AI challenge; reflections on building AI-native and on what to build when SaaS is dead.

Practical framework for working with AI collaboratively, inspired by the mismatch between AI outputs and the questions people actually need answered.
